Phase 84 AUDIT workstream - independent live re-verification of the Phase 83 audit posture against the Wazuh indexer (OpenSearch security plugin, 3-node cluster 'wazuh-cluster', status green) on 2026-08-31. The 16 keys were NOT inherited from Phase 83; each was re-checked against the live security config, live audit indices, live roles/users, and the alerting monitor. Operator approval: granted. Connection used the admin client credential from /opt/wazuh-docker/multi-node/ops/creds.env sourced in-process; no secret value was printed, logged, or written to any artifact. Reconciliation to Phase 83 evidence (ops/reports/evidence/phase83/phase83-evidence-audit.json):

1) audit_enabled: re-verified live. GET /_plugins/_security/api/audit returns top-level enabled:true and audit.enabled:true; the live index security-auditlog-2026.08.31 holds 107,705 docs and is still growing, so the audit pipeline is still capturing. Reconciles with Phase 83.

2) failed_login / authenticated / missing_privileges / ssl_exception: re-verified live via terms aggregation on audit_category.keyword over security-auditlog-*. Live counts: FAILED_LOGIN=78,275; AUTHENTICATED=11,022; MISSING_PRIVILEGES=6; SSL_EXCEPTION=11. disabled_rest_categories and disabled_transport_categories are empty, so all default categories remain active. Reconciles with Phase 83 (which enabled AUTHENTICATED/GRANTED_PRIVILEGES and confirmed the failure categories).

3) security_index_denial: re-verified live. A transient least-privilege user (no roles) was created, issued GET /.opendistro_security/_search, and returned HTTP 403 (denied), then was immediately deleted and confirmed NOT_FOUND. A config check shows only the audit_viewer role is granted .opendistro_security (read/search); no broad/anonymous role grants it. Matches Phase 83's denial posture.

4) authorization_headers_absent / cookies_absent: re-verified live. A query_string scan of all audit docs for 'authorization'/'Authorization' and 'cookie' returned 0 hits; the audit config has exclude_sensitive_headers:true. No Authorization headers or cookies are present in any audit document.

5) credentials_absent / secret_derived_values_absent: re-verified live. A query_string scan for password / credential / secret / bearer / token / api_key across all audit doc fields returned 0 hits. No credential or secret-derived values appear in audit docs; audit_transport_headers carry only OpenSearch security-plugin internal headers (remote address, origin, user) - no secrets.

6) sensitive_bodies_absent: re-verified live. The audit config has log_request_body:false; sampled audit docs contain no request-body field. Request bodies are not logged in plaintext.

7) retention_policy: re-verified live. ISM policy 'security-auditlog-retention' exists (states hot -> delete on min_index_age 180d, with a delete action) and is attached to security-auditlog-* via the index template 'security-auditlog-template' (policy_id set). The 180-day retention is enforced; per-day index creation by the security plugin provides natural rollover. Reconciles with Phase 83 (which replaced a malformed prior policy).

8) access_restricted: re-verified live. An anonymous GET /.opendistro_security/_search returned 401 (auth required). The dedicated read-only role 'audit_viewer' exists (cluster_composite_ops_ro; read/search on security-auditlog-* and .opendistro_security). Least-priv users are denied (see security_index_denial). Reconciles with Phase 83.

9) monitor_alert: re-verified live. Alerting monitor 'phase83-failed-login-spike' exists, is enabled:true, runs every 1 minute, searches security-auditlog-* for audit_category.keyword=FAILED_LOGIN over the last 5m, and triggers (severity 2) when hits.total.value > 200. The monitor is correctly wired to the live audit index. Reconciles with Phase 83.

10) capacity_guard: re-verified live. Cluster disk watermark thresholds are present (low 85%, high 90%, flood_stage 95%). Audit growth is bounded by daily security-auditlog-YYYY.MM.DD index creation (natural rollover) plus the ISM 180-day delete, preventing unbounded disk consumption. Reconciles with Phase 83.
